notes.title: V1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]V1.5 Update Highlights:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where buildings could not be selected.
[*] Added the ability to sell the selected building by pressing “T”.
[*] Pressing the right mouse button can now cancel a building currently under construction.
[/olist]

[h3]Control Instructions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Use W, A, S, D to move the camera.
[*] Press R to repair a selected building.
[*] Press T to sell a selected building.
[*] Press H to return to the base view.
[*] Click on the building icons on the right side to purchase.
[*] Once the icon is ready, click on it to start construction.
[*] Drag the transparent building in the field to move it.
[*] Press Spacebar to complete the construction.
[*] Press Q to cancel construction.
[*] Press F to rotate a building.
[*] Press Z to select all ground defense towers.
[*] Press X to select all anti-air defense towers.
[*] Press C to select all defense towers.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug where buildings could not be selected.

tags.feature: [*] Added the ability to sell the selected building by pressing “T”.
[*] Pressing the right mouse button can now cancel a building currently under construction.

notes.title: DEMO V1.05 Update Content
notes.content:
DEMO V1.05 Update Content
[olist]
[*] Fixed the abnormal bug in Level 7.
[/olist]

We had already fixed the following issues in a previous minor update:
[olist]
[*] Corrected some errors in the construction of building units.
[*] Fixed some functional abnormalities.
[/olist]

If you encounter a problem where building units cannot be placed in the game, you can first click the settings button and then return to the game. We will completely resolve this issue in the official version.


[u][b]If you encounter any issues in the game, please feel free to provide feedback on the STEAM Community. We will do our best to address them![/b][/u]
